title: toona sureni var. cochinchinensis
intro: Toona sureni var. cochinchinensis, commonly known as the Cochinchinensis Toona, is a variety of the Toona sureni plant, which is a member of the Mahogany family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Toona sureni var. cochinchinensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antipyretic, and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
